text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq marks President Saddam Hussein's 60th birthday.
- Iraq backs a Chinese and Russian declaration rejecting hegemony by one state of world events.
- Trade ministry decides to increase government rations of rice and other commodities in May.
- Iraqi helicopters complete flying of pilgrims to provinces throughout Iraq.
- Celebrations continue throughout Iraq marking Saddam's birthday.
- Culture and information minister receives Russian literary delegation.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Iraq succeeds in defeating Washington on eve of Saddam's birthday anniversary.
- Several articles on the meanings and significance of Saddam's birthday anniversary.
